name: Aldous Penhallow
title: Reeve of Brindle
greeting: Ah. A traveller. Splendid. Do you happen to be any good at finding things?
Yes, yes, what is it? I am a very busy man. Extremely busy. Mostly worrying.

name: Mother Tansy
title: keeper of the Gilded Goose
greeting: Come in out of the weather, love. Well. Stand near the door, anyway.
You look like you've walked a long way. You look like you've walked it badly, too.

name: Wilmot Crane
title: purveyor of sundries
greeting: Draughts, tinctures, whetstones, and string! Everyone needs string.
Wilmot Crane, purveyor of sundries. You look like a woman in need of sundries.

name: Sergeant Holt
title: of the south gate
greeting: Move along. Or don't. I'm not your mother.
Gate's open. Barrow's that way. If you die, I'm not carrying you back.

name: Pike
title: of the north gate
greeting: Halt! Oh. Sorry. Force of habit. Carry on.
Nothing ever comes through the north gate. That's what makes it the best gate.

name: Sister Ide
title: of the Temple of the Lantern
greeting: The Lantern keeps you, child. Mostly. Within reason.
Light and warmth to you. You smell of the road.

name: Hobb
title: the smith
greeting: Mind the anvil. It bites.
If you've come about the noise, it's called work.

name: Old Nell
title: who has seen things
greeting: I knew your grandmother. Or someone very like her. Probably.
Sit down, sit down. Not there.

name: Bram
title: the miller's lad
greeting: Is that a real sword? Can I hold it? I won't stab anyone. Much.
You're not from round here. Nobody's not from round here.

name: Mags Fennimore
title: who sells eggs
greeting: Eggs? No? Suit yourself. They are very good eggs.
Morning. Or whatever it is. I lose track.

name: Pell Hardacre
title: who is mostly at the Goose
greeting: You're new. I'm not. I've been here since lunch. Which lunch, I couldn't tell you.
Pull up a stool. Not that one, that one bites.

name: Ottilie Marsh
title: clerk to the Reeve
greeting: Do you have an appointment? No? Nobody does. Go on, then.
If it's about the ring, he knows. Believe me, he knows.

name: Widow Ashby
title: who keeps a tidy house
greeting: Boots! Mind your boots on my floor.
Visitors. How unexpected. I shall have to pretend to be pleased.

name: Tam
title: the miller's youngest
greeting: Are you a robber? You look like a robber. A nice one.
Bram says there's a ghost in the barrow. Bram says a lot of things.
